name: Klaus-Dieter Adler
bio: Klaus-Dieter Adler's motorsport journey began with a passion for engineering and a fascination with the precision of Formula 1. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he started his career in the aerodynamics department of a smaller racing team. His meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of performance improvements quickly gained him recognition. He then moved into team management, where he combines his technical expertise with a results-oriented leadership style. Adler is known for his ability to identify and nurture talent, pushing his teams to achieve consistent success. He joined Birel ART Factory seeking a new challenge, confident he can bring a world championship to the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build, Klaus always looks sharply dressed in team wear.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Insists on having a perfectly clean and organized workspace.
Frequently reviews telemetry data even during social events.
